title: Five Eight
author: J.amy
about: That's a pen name. And this is an open notebook where I explore whatever is happening right now. A scrapbook of life snippets without the ticket stubs to prove any of it actually happened. If anything here makes sense or has a recognizable form, then cool, but that's not the point. My goal isn’t to write anything that’s any good. It’s to hear the fleeting impressions in my own head and memory, to give them an outlet and a voice, to try to bottom-out this burnout and maybe even turn a corner.
